timing_audit.notes: No timing codes changed. Broad timing labels do not establish a measured delay since the intervention ended.

flags.finding: Outcome is the first question of the next topic; current notes give no elapsed interval. Verify whether delayed means a later retention wave or within-platform transfer before reclassification.
Older subagent inputs say delayed (5 months), but the current builder explicitly explains that five months is course length and the exam is terminal. Keep the current code; old inputs are stale.
The September 2026 PDF and matching regression outputs identify Session Two as one week later. Updated endpoint estimates preserve the delayed timing code.

exclusions.reason: Excluded under the stated minimum of 50 participants per study. The whole trial randomized 33 students; the 21-person AI-versus-institutional-resources contrast was correctly recorded, but does not make the study eligible.
